cues.text:
This loan screener asks
the OpenAI Decisions API

for calibrated probabilities, then
applies policy in plain code.

For a borderline file, the
underwriter node calls interrupt.

The whole state is saved in a
checkpoint under the thread I D,
and nothing runs until someone answers.

A Command carrying a resume value
wakes the same thread exactly

where it stopped, and the
decision flows on to the letter.
